name: @hugegraph/hgbench
description: HugeGraph benchmark controller: versioned component protocols and reproducible evidence

scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:benchmark
scripts.format: prettier --write src components examples tests-normative adapters tools/*.mjs benchmarks/*/*.mjs package.json tsconfig.json
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src components examples tests-normative adapters tools/*.mjs benchmarks/*/*.mjs package.json tsconfig.json
scripts.test:benchmark: node benchmarks/core-read-v0.1/reference.mjs verify && node tools/test-normative.mjs && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests-normative -p 'test_*.py'
